Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct-AWQ.description: 32B parameter model quantized to INT4 AWQ. Requires ~18-20 GB VRAM. On single consumer GPU (8GB/12GB), requires CPU offload or tensor/pipeline parallelism across nodes (Phase 2).
Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct-AWQ.recommended_hardware: 2x GPUs via Ray/Pipeline Parallelism or single GPU >= 24GB VRAM

Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-AWQ.description: 14B parameter model quantized to INT4 AWQ. Weights ~8.5 GB. Ideal for 12GB VRAM cards.

Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-AWQ.description: 7B parameter model quantized to INT4 AWQ. Weights ~4.5 GB. Perfect single-GPU testing benchmark for 8GB VRAM (RTX 4070 Laptop).
